verdict.rationale: The documentation index lists a first-party "Get Account Payment (ACH) details" capability alongside account validation and ownership verification for accounts linked via Connect, so the product directly offers ACH detail retrieval from a linked account. However, the evidence consists only of index-level headings and never describes the returned fields or the payment-funding flow. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that account and routing numbers (or tokenized equivalents) are returned, documentation that this replaces micro-deposits, details of the ACH funding flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can obtain verified account and routing numbers (or tokenized equivalents) from a linked account to fund ACH or bank-debit payments without micro-deposits

citations.quote: Get Account Payment (ACH) details ... Verify account ownership ... Validate account details
link them to at least one account via Connect
